assumptions.hbm: 60% of 460 GB/s, fpga_est divisible placement with 90% on-chip capacity
assumptions.compute: Dense projections include full-head readout. W4A8 at 1 or 2 MACs/DSP-cycle, packed W4A4 at 3. Event updates in LUT fabric. II=1 assumes independent accumulator inputs or a feedback path that sustains one update per cycle

accumulators.yosys: Synthesized fabric accumulators and registers, including signed packing and extraction where used
accumulators.dsp_zero_fabric: Ideal resource envelope charging only DSPs for dense lanes. P feedback can hold one 32-bit sum. At 2/3 MACs per DSP this is a counterfactual with free packing, extraction and external accumulation, since P cannot hold independent 32-bit sums for all outputs

assumptions.area: LUT and carry budget applied independently; carry halves assume ideal pairing, FF packing and routing unmodeled
assumptions.reads: One weight row per nonzero level; perfect shared-row broadcast over independent streams, no bank conflicts
assumptions.memory: One 64-data-bit read per active bank per cycle. Active-bank fractions model delivered bandwidth; 10% is a stress case. Resident state ports, accumulator traffic and scale reads unmodeled
assumptions.bounds: Projection-only. Primary at 1 stream is serial engines, with memory allowed to overlap. The 1-stream parallel counterfactual requires independent work absent from a single token chain. At 16 streams the primary overlap bound assumes independent stream work and scheduling that exposes it
assumptions.c: Per spike-sum weight update, in each dense layout's DSP MAC units. Event c charges event-engine time. Effective c charges marginal time vs dense work at the same placement
assumptions.limits: Cell counts give neither achievable clock nor dynamic power. No measured board timing or energy
